# Sixth Vision Commercial — commercial real estate photographer, Melbourne
# https://sixthvisioncommercial.com.au/

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Nothing here is private; the whole site is one page plus its assets.
# Explicitly allow the media so Google Images can index the portfolio.
Allow: /assets/img/
Allow: /assets/video/

# Housekeeping folders that must never be indexed if they are ever deployed.
Disallow: /archive-v2/
Disallow: /archive-25fps/
Disallow: /archive-unused-assets/
Disallow: /.claude/

# ChatGPT Search discovery — OAI-SearchBot is the crawler OpenAI uses for search inclusion.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

# Perplexity live/search retrieval. PerplexityBot builds its search index; Perplexity-User supports user-requested retrieval.
User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Perplexity-User
Allow: /

# Claude live user retrieval. ClaudeBot (training crawler) is intentionally not given a separate override here.
User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://sixthvisioncommercial.com.au/sitemap.xml
